chunks: The Shaykh Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام informed me, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Abān, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ḥammād and Faḍālah, from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a mouse and a gecko that fall into the well. He said: Three buckets are to be drawn from it.

key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: the well into which the animal falls
key_terms.الْفَأْرَةِ: a mouse; the animal mentioned in the ruling regarding the well
key_terms.الْوَزَغَةِ: a gecko; the other creature mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.ثَلَاثُ دِلَاءٍ: three buckets; the specified amount to be drawn
key_terms.يُنْزَحُ: water is to be drawn out; the prescribed act of removing water

ai.seo_question: What should be done if a mouse or gecko falls into a well according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning ritual purity when a mouse or gecko falls into a well. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام instructs that three buckets of water should be drawn from the well, indicating the required measure of purification in this case.
